selection: The three existing selected 511-update worlds; fixed horizons, no selection for increasing complexity.

observations.early: Diagonal lanes emerge from the finely mottled opening rows, with dark gaps between several colored regions.
observations.middle: The added history contains intersecting bands, fine stripes and irregular patches; earlier lanes do not remain uniform throughout.
observations.late: Further diagonal bands and interrupted textures accumulate. The final rows remain visually mixed rather than settling into one broad band.

observations.late: Broad green and blue diagonal regions dominate the late addition. The yellow middle bands stay visible above because this is cumulative history.
